The plaintiff is engaged in the business of manufacturing and marketing of buttons, safety pins, hooks, eyelets, fastners etc. since the year 1989. Since the year 1989 the plaintiff has been using the trade mark "555" for its products for the purpose of indicating or so as to indicate a connection in the course of trade between the said products and the plaintiff firm. On account of continuous, regular and extensive use of the said trade mark "555" in respect of the said products of the plaintiff, the said mark has come to be associated with the plaintiff and none else. Gokal Chand Hari Chand have been selling their goods under the trade mark "555" and a few months ago, the distributorship of the defendant was cancelled due to certain reasons. When the products of the defendant came in the hands of the plaintiff, the plaintiff came to know that the defendant has also started marketing its products of buttons, safety pins under the similar trade mark "555" as those of the plaintiff. The adoption and use of the said trademark"555" by the defendant for its products buttons and safety pins is an act of piracy of the plaintiff's mark and the defendant is also guilty of passing off its inferior quality goods as high quality goods of the plaintiff under the said trade mark of the plaintiff.
